problem:
Which of the following statements are true, given that $A$ is a $5\times 5$ matrix and 

$$
\text{Null}(A)={[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ 0 \\ 2{x}_{2} \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]\,|\,{x}_{1},{x}_{2}\in R}?
$$

- $\text{dim(Null}(A))=0$
- $A$ is  invertible
- $\text{Col}(A)\ne {R}^{5}$

choices.value: None of the statements are true

activity_context.topic_title: The Invertible Matrix Theorem in Terms of Dimension, Rank and Nullity
